finding_id.format: prefix + mechanism + ':' + source_card_id + ':' + source_capability_id + ':' + target_card_id + ':' + target_capability_id, where the capability ids come from capabilities[row[0]].id and capabilities[row[1]].id and the card ids are their leading digits

cls.uc: useful conditional interaction: source-bound and play-relevant when its capability conditions hold
cls.uac: useful conditional with an alternate contribution: the cited clause cannot support the payoff, but another clause of the same card contributes a qualifying object. 13 rows are The Misty Mountains Cold: its Treasure tokens are artifacts, so they cannot pay creature-count, creature-pump, creature-death or creature-only-sacrifice costs, but the same chapter ability ('I, II, III, IV - Create a Treasure token. Then if you control four or more Treasures, sacrifice this Saga. If you do, create a 6/6 red Dragon creature token with flying.') creates the Dragon once, on the first chapter I-IV whose Treasure brings the count to four or more (as early as chapter I when three other Treasures are already controlled, and never if the check still fails when the Saga is sacrificed after IV). 4 rows are graveyard rows whose cited clause consumes the graveyard while another clause of the same card adds one there: 103390 The Mountain-king's Return (the cited chapter II returns a card from the graveyard to the battlefield; chapter I recruit's discard puts one in) and 103543 Silvan Reveler (the cited etb land-redirect moves a discarded land from the graveyard to the battlefield; the same etb draw-then-discard puts one in when the discarded card is a nonland)
cls.mxg: contradiction (full oracle text checked): Bolg's Company sacrifices 'another Goblin'; no clause of the paired source produces a Goblin, so the pairing cannot be used
cls.mxe: contradiction (full oracle text checked): Thranduil's 'Other Elves you control get +1/+1' cannot apply to the source's tokens, and Thranduil has no type-conversion clause that could turn them into Elves
cls.mxd: contradiction, graveyard zone direction (full oracle text checked): the cited clause takes cards out of a graveyard the payoff counts instead of adding them. Flashback casts the card from the graveyard and then exiles it (103389 Moment of Glory, 103425 Plunder the Trollshaws, 103494 Tidings of War); return-from-graveyard clauses move cards to hand or to the battlefield (103390 chapter II, 103434 Along the Crooked Way, 103442 Gathering of Darkness, 103447 Gollum the Abandoned, 103535 Eagle's Rescue); 103462 Supper for Spiders puts opponents' creature cards onto your battlefield as Food artifacts that lose all other types. None of these can reach the threshold of 103420 ('each graveyard with seven or more cards in it') or 103422 ('seven or more cards in your graveyard')
cls.ucc: useful conditional, resolved from the frozen Oracle text: Azog, Moria's Ruin reads 'When Azog enters, destroy up to one other target creature. Its controller amasses Goblins X, where X is that creature's power. If you controlled that creature, draw a card.' The destroyed creature's controller gets the Army, so the pairing is useful only when Azog destroys a creature you control. The saved evidence quoted only the amass reminder; the fact itself is resolved, not missing.
cls.mrd: record defect - role direction: Bard, King of Dale reads 'If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.' It is a token-doubling payoff/modifier and creates no token itself, yet the saved rows place it on the provider side of token relationships. These rows need a corrected payoff model (Bard as modifier of another source's tokens), not more Oracle evidence.
cls.evidence_basis: classes re-adjudicated against the full oracle text of both cards in card-database.json, not only the quoted fragment: the 27 recursion rows were screened for graveyard zone direction - 7 rows whose cited mill clause adds cards to the graveyard stay uc, 4 rows on 103390 and 103543 are uac on their other supplying clause, 16 rows whose cited clause removes graveyard cards are mxd (flashback exiles, return clauses move cards out, Supper for Spiders takes opponents' cards); the 13 Misty Mountains Cold rows are uac under the printed four-or-more-Treasure check and the once-per-saga Dragon, not fourth-chapter completion; the rows pairing non-Bear token makers with Beorn the Fierce stay useful because Beorn's combat trigger makes a target creature a Bear in addition to its types; mxg and mxe were confirmed against full text (no paired source has a Goblin or Elf conversion); the Azog rows are resolved as ucc from his own controller clause; the Bard rows are a role-direction defect (mrd) in the saved payoff model

gap.fu: citation frame unrepresentable: the cited predicate sits behind a compressed keyword instruction or conditional frame the closed clause window cannot express
gap.nadj: no adjacent operation/object pair: no closed-grammar object phrase touches the operation
gap.af: clause assembly failed: candidate spans could not form one maximal typed clause
gap.opn: no object phrase: no closed-grammar object run exists inside the cited region
gap.oos: operation span outside cited regions: the operation lexeme only occurs outside the evidence
gap.ou: operation unrecognized: the cited predicate states no single closed operation

legends.row: each findings[mechanism] entry is [source_capability_index, target_capability_index, cls, '<stage>:<gap>']; '-' means the typed projection was emitted; indices address the capabilities array

condition_definitions.storied: frozen printed reminder text (103382 Fíli the Pathfinder and eight further cards in card-database.json): 'Storied (If you control three or more artifacts, legendaries, and/or Sagas, you have an enduring story for the rest of the game.)' The threshold counts artifacts, legendaries and Sagas together - three or more permanents in any combination, a legendary artifact counting once - and once it is met the enduring story lasts for the rest of the game, so losing the qualifying permanents does not remove it. The 34 rows targeting 103382-enduring-story-anthem are conditional on that attained state (inactive before the threshold, live for the rest of the game afterwards), not on a generic creature entering.
condition_definitions.recruit_discard: frozen printed reminder text ('Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.'): the draw happens first, so an empty hand does not exclude the token (the drawn card can be discarded); the discard is a mandatory instruction once the ability resolves, and the token depends on the card actually discarded being a nonland. Whether recruit happens at all is decided by the parent ability, which is a separate fact.
